Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1307
Claimant:
Chelsea Terry
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
3-29-24
Claim reported by the policyholder after a sideswipe on the highway during a lane change. The claimant, a passenger
in the other vehicle, reports neck pain and has no lawyer representing them.
4-20-24
Reviewed the police report and the photos from the scene. The damage to both vehicles is mostly in line with the
impact described, and the police confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time.
4-21-24
Spoke with the other driver, who gave the same account of the lane change and the contact between the vehicles.
Witness statements match this version of events.
6-5-24
Claimant was asked about prior injuries to the neck and upper back and reported none. No earlier injury to that body
area is known from available records.
7-31-24
Claimant repeated the same account of the collision in each conversation so far. The reported neck strain is plausible
for a sideswipe of this type.
9-3-24
Vehicle inspection completed. No earlier damage to the claimant's vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the
damage predates the start of coverage.
9-9-24
Confirmed the driver of the policyholder's vehicle lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member
under the policy.
10-7-24
Treatment for the neck strain followed a usual course and has tapered off as the claimant improved. Claim remains
open pending final medical update.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
